thread:
incident-bot: :warning: [P1] GPU capacity exhaustion detected in us-west-2-prod. GPU queue >120% baseline, autoscaler reporting failures to attach new nodes. Paging infra-oncall. <https://redwood/ops/INC-8249|INC-8249>

maria: ack. I'm seeing a spike in the gpu-queue metric and a bunch of `AttachInstanceProfile` errors in the autoscaler logs. I'm pulling logs now.

sam: on it, checking autoscaler -> ASG -> launch template chain. Quick check: `kubectl get nodes` shows steady node count, pods Pending=42 (mostly gpu-worker).

carter: paste from autoscaler logs: ```ERROR autoscaler: could not create instance: error creating launch config: LaunchTemplateVersionNotFound: The specified launch template version does not exist
status code: 400, request id: abc-123
Caused by: AttachRole/AccessDenied: iam:PassRole denied for instance profile arn:aws:iam::123456:instance-profile/gpu-node-profile
```

anya: customer-impact update: CS reports 5 customers seeing >30s latency on text-generation endpoints; rate-limited and some 5xx retries. Marking as customer impactful. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

kevin: suggestion: divert non-urgent batch and retryable requests to cpu-fallback queue and reduce concurrency on hosted API routes while we stabilize. Can we flip a temporary routing rule?

maria: started manual scale: `aws autoscaling set-desired-capacity --auto-scaling-group-name nodegroup-prod-gpu --desired-capacity 12` but new instances are failing to register — see LaunchTemplateVersionNotFound above. Looks like autoscaler references LT id  lt-0aa111 but our latest rollout updated to lt-0bb222 and removed old version.

sam: that's the handshake issue. Autoscaler config pinned to LT id -> version that got pruned in the recent infra rollout. Need to reconcile instance-profile and launch template version.

carter: mitigation plan: 1) create ephemeral ASG with correct launch template and instance profile to admit gpu nodes, 2) cordon/evict noncritical training pods, 3) apply temporary routing limits. I'm starting step 2 now.

maria: creating ephemeral ASG: ```aws autoscaling create-auto-scaling-group --auto-scaling-group-name temp-gpu-8249 --launch-template LaunchTemplateId=lt-0bb222,Version='$Latest' --min-size 0 --max-size 6 --desired-capacity 4 --vpc-zone-identifier "subnet-aaa,subnet-bbb"```

kevin: I applied a temporary traffic rule on the API gateway to reduce parallelism for the /generate endpoint by 50% and moved large-batch jobs to cpu-fallback. Monitoring customer latency.

anya: notified CS and AMs: initial message sent, customers informed we have mitigation in progress and ETA ~20-30m.

sam: after spinning up temp ASG, instances boot but `kubelet` fails to register: logs show attach role denied on the IAM instance profile. Looks like the instance profile name in the LT was changed during rollout and the autoscaler assumptions didn't update.

maria: applying quick fix: attaching the expected instance profile name to the LT version referenced by autoscaler via `aws ec2 modify-launch-template --launch-template-id lt-0aa111 --launch-template-name nodegroup-legacy --default-version 1` (rolling back IAM profile change) — will keep as short-term stopgap.

carter: cordoned 3 noncritical nodes, evicted low-priority pods -> freed 8 GPUs. That dropped pending from 42 -> 27. Queue still high but trending down.

incident-bot: update: queue metric decreased -18% over 10m since mitigation started. Autoscaler still intermittently logging `AttachRole` errors.

sam: root cause summary: recent infra rollout replaced instance profile/launch template versions; autoscaler config wasn't updated to target the new template/version and the old template ID was retired. When autoscaler attempted scale, LT version lookups failed and IAM pass-role checks refused new instances.

maria: next steps: 1) reconcile autoscaler config to point to lt-0bb222 stable version (in progress), 2) add validation to rollout pipeline to not prune LT versions referenced by cluster-autoscaler, 3) create runbook entry for LT/InstanceProfile handshake.

kevin: I'll keep the temporary API throttles for now and watch for customer errors. Please post an ETA before we remove throttles.

anya: handoff: I'll coordinate customer comms and update INC-8249. Owners for postmortem: sam (infra/autoscaler), carter (sre/mitigation), maria (ops/infra). ETA for mitigation = 25m, next status update in 10m.

maria: applied autoscaler config patch to reference latest LT id; performing a controlled scale test now. Test `kubectl get nodes` showing 3 new GPU nodes registered.\n
carter: great — draining plan to move jobs back to normal queues once stable.

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Mitigation progress: new nodes registered, pending queue reduced to 9, customer-facing errors decreased. Marking as under control. Please file postmortem and link to INC-8249.

sam: will open PR to runbook (ops/launch-template-validation) and add CI gate to infra deploys to ensure autoscaler references are updated or templates are kept for a grace window.

anya: thanks everyone — handing off to post-incident follow-ups. :thumbsup:
